records.name: OX212
records.tagline: Don't predict the market, predict the trader
records.description: OX212 reads you while you trade, sees you about to break your plan and pauses the account when your rules say so. Every decision sealed in Bitcoin. Works with NinjaTrader, Tradovate, MT5, Quantower, cTrader, ChatGPT and Claude.

records.name: ICONS
records.tagline: Where brands book creators, or license their AI likeness
records.description: ICONS is where brands book creators, influencers and celebrities for sponsored posts, or license a creator's likeness for AI content. Creators set their rates and approve every script and final cut. Contracts and payments live in one place.

records.name: canfit
records.tagline: The top command for people running local LLMs and apps
records.description: canfit tells you if a local model or app can launch right now, and if not, what you can safely close to make room. System processes are never touched. Open-source Rust TUI/CLI for macOS, Windows and Linux, no telemetry.

records.name: Toone
records.tagline: Grokbot meets n8n/zapier
records.description: Toone: Grokbot meets n8n/zapier. Build precise agentic workflows and routines in natural language. Each node is an agent's chat thread on the model you pick (ChatGPT or Claude), or an automatic step that runs the same way every time without AI. Run repeatable routines, babysit them with agents, polish as they run, pause and continue anytime. Plus live share, meeting notes, Spotlight-style layouts, Zen Mode, Calendar, Quick Capture, Git, and MCPs for research, SEO and more.

records.name: dusk bot
records.tagline: free open source Grok bot alternative
records.description: Best free Grok bot alternative. Use the ChatGPT, Claude or Grok plan you already pay for and get a team of bots, each with a job, a memory you can edit and its own computer. They run on a schedule, ask before risky steps, and live in a calm, polished chat app. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, OpenRouter or a local model, on your own sign-in. 100% free and open source

records.name: Ody Ai Business Phone
records.tagline: Shared workspace + manageable AI agents
records.description: Already trusted by 4K+ businesses. Ody combines a shared team workspace on one business number with highly manageable AI agents. Rare to get both. Native iOS + Android (+ web). AI calls inbound and outbound, AI texting, and workflows for the granular details that matter: AI voice-to-text, link tracking, REST API, SDKs, MCP, and Switchboard. Port your number. 7-day free trial.

records.name: lepoly
records.tagline: One place for all your 3D assets
records.description: lepoly is a digital asset management platform built for 3D. Host, organize, review, and share, all from the browser.

records.name: Qwen4-Max
records.tagline: Qwen's new flagship for long-running agent work
records.description: Qwen4-Max is the first flagship built on Qwen's new 2.4T-parameter architecture, with native vision and a 1M-token context window. It supports coding, professional workflows, and long-running agent tasks, with API access available now.

records.name: SoreQen Code
records.tagline: The coding agent that checks its own work
records.description: SoreQen Code is an autonomous coding agent by ZorQelis AI. Describe a task and it reads your project, makes a plan, edits files, runs commands and tests, checks its own work, and tells you plainly what it did. Use it in the SoreQen desktop app or the open-source CLI, and approve steps from your phone when you are away. It runs on 18 models with one credit balance, and SoreQen Auto picks the right one for each step. Free to start.

records.name: Incredible Agents
records.tagline: Fast Voice AI that sees your screen and runs your agents
records.description: The heavily asked for INCREDIBLE AGENTS update is finally here! Your voice can now: (1) CREATE new agents that work directly on your computer, in apps, browsers and files. (2) RUN work on repeat, 24/7. (3) BUILD live sharable pages, dashboards, apps and more. Incredible PROACTIVELY FINDS WORK AI agents can do for you, and sets the agent up. Agents do the work directly on your computer, the way you do, 24/7. FREE TO TRY. Mac and Windows.

records.name: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
records.tagline: Two new OpenAI models: frontier Astra and efficient Sol
records.description: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are OpenAI’s new models for professional work. Astra is the frontier model for the hardest projects, like slides, websites, 3D designs and science research. Sol is the efficient everyday model for coding and multistep agent work. Per OpenAI, Astra costs under a third per task of GPT-6 Astra. API pricing per million tokens: Astra $8 in, $40 out; Sol $2 in, $10 out. Live in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu, plus the API.

records.name: Orken
records.tagline: Tell it your time and gear. Get a workout built for you.
records.description: Ready-made workouts are the same for everyone, and training plans want 12 weeks. Orken builds a workout for today instead. Choose how much time you have (10–60 min) and home or gym, then pick strength, cardio, or mobility and core. Every workout fits your level and the gear you have, and a guided timer with sound and haptics takes you through it. Free to download, no account, no ads, works offline.

records.name: kwatch
records.tagline: Kubernetes alerts that name the root cause
records.description: kwatch finds the one cause behind a Kubernetes failure and sends one message: what broke, why, who changed it, what to do next. To Slack, Teams, email and 50+ channels. Source available (ELv2); Pro free during early access.

records.name: KaDeep AI
records.tagline: AI QA, localization and accessibility to know when to ship
records.description: KaDeep Studio Pro is an AI agent that tells you whether a release is ready to ship. Describe a test in plain English and it runs on your web app, iOS or Android build, or desktop app. It localizes 100+ file formats, from app strings and PDFs to Office files, images, SCORM and video, and checks every language in the real build. It audits accessibility under any law: WCAG 2.2, ADA, EAA, Section 508, EN 301 549 and 14 more. Its open-source CLI makes it a go / no-go gate in CI. Free to start.

records.name: Polylane for CI
records.tagline: Fix broken builds before they block your team
records.description: When CI fails on main or in your merge queue, Polylane reads the job logs, finds the commit that broke the build, and opens a fix pull request. It runs your build and tests before review, fixes CI failures on its own PRs, and closes the issue when main is green again. Works with GitHub Actions, Depot, and CI that reports checks to GitHub.

records.name: Tencent Hy4 flash
records.tagline: Fast, low-cost model from $0.07/M input
records.description: Hy4 flash is Tencent’s most cost-effective Hy model to date, with 224B total parameters, 12B active, multimodal input and a 1M-token context. Per Tencent, it decodes above 150 tokens per second and costs about $0.07 per million input tokens and $0.28 output. It targets everyday tasks like document work, slides, deep research and computer use, while Hy4 handles harder engineering. Open-sourcing is planned, but the weights are not out yet.

records.name: S.Space
records.tagline: Your team and everyone's AI agents, in one workspace
records.description: Everyone on your team has an AI agent, and none of them work together, so you copy, paste and re-explain all day. S.Space is one workspace for your team and everyone's agents. Bring the ones you already use, like Claude Code and Codex, from any vendor. Agents reach out, hand work to each other and bring you finished results, with shared memory so you explain things once. Agents act, you approve what matters. Free to start. Built by the team behind AutoGen.

records.name: Mermaid Flow
records.tagline: The visual builder for agentic workflows
records.description: Mermaid Flow lets you build agentic workflows as diagrams, then run them. Think issue triage, weekly recaps, PR reviews: work you'd otherwise hand to a long prompt or a skill file. Describe what you want, start from a template, or bring the file, and you get a workflow with every step laid out. Connect Github, Slack, Notion, and more in one click, then hit run or put it on a schedule. Every run is saved step by step, so you can see what happened and your team can follow along. Free to start.

records.name: Kino
records.tagline: Store, edit and review video with Claude Code and Codex
records.description: Kino lets you make great videos with your agents and your teammates. Storage of footage and assets, a rich video editor, and review links for teammates are all bundled into one. Your colleagues and Codex / Claude Code can work on the same timeline with review notes and footage all in one place. All editing is expressed as code, built on Remotion, so you can drag and nudge anything your agent made without prompting again. The full editor is free.

records.name: Pitch Avatar HR Suite
records.tagline: Onboarding, training & comms with conversational AI avatars
records.description: HR teams should be talking to people. Instead, up to 70% of the day goes to onboarding, mandatory training, and the same questions again and again, with no way to tell what works. HR Suite automates it with conversational AI avatars. They teach from your materials and answer employees’ questions in lessons and as an HR assistant. Reminders keep people on track; HR sees who finished and where they got stuck. Free 14-day trial + 50% off any plan with code PRODUCTHUNT2026 until Nov 30.

records.name: Bluedot Phone Calls
records.tagline: AI note taker for phone calls
records.description: Bluedot now covers phone calls, not just meetings. Dial from the web or mobile app, keep your own caller ID, and get a transcript, summary and action items automatically.

records.name: Waldo by Wherobots
records.tagline: The AI agent that accelerates engineering with spatial data
records.description: Waldo is the geospatial data agent that turns questions about the physical world into answers, maps, and production-ready data pipelines. It analyzes satellite imagery, geometries, geography data, and your organization's first party data, writes and debugs the analysis, and delivers results in hours. When the work needs to run continuously, Waldo turns it into a scheduled pipeline on your existing data platform. Built for spatial analytics at scale by the creators of Apache Sedona.

records.name: Review Box
records.tagline: A fast desktop app for reviewing GitHub pull requests
records.description: A fast desktop app for reviewing GitHub pull requests. Track reviewed files, jump to symbol definitions and uses, search the whole PR and ask AI about changes.

records.name: Happo animation testing
records.tagline: Visual regression testing, now for animations
records.description: Happo is visual regression testing and accessibility testing for websites, web apps, and native apps. On every pull request, it screenshots your UI in Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge and shows you what changed before it ships. Now Happo tests animations too. It captures every frame, so a change to how something moves shows up as a diff. Step through frame by frame or swipe between before and after. Happo animation testing is free through 2026.

records.name: SaaS Toolkit MCP
records.tagline: An SDR and CMO on your site 24/7, for one JavaScript snippet
records.description: Drop one JavaScript snippet on your site. SaaS Toolkit becomes your 24/7 sales and marketing arm: • AI chat steps in when a visitor is ready to buy or about to leave • Anonymous visitors become named leads • Emails triggered by what they do • Stripe revenue, Slack alerts, ad conversions, webhooks • Add the Website SDR: it calls hot leads and books meetings New: the MCP. Your AI agents run it from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor: ask, reply, follow up. MCP included on every plan, even free Starter.

records.name: Dippr
records.tagline: A data platform served to your agents, with one prompt
records.description: It’s where your agents build and run your company’s software, tools and apps – with access to your company data across sources, the context to understand it, and the rules to use it safely.

records.name: Stringman
records.tagline: Turns your room into a crane game
records.description: Clean up playrooms, or automate transport in multi-robot setups. Stringman is a room-scale CDPR for pick and place tasks. 2-dof gripper with a 2kg payload. Stays suspended overhead by braided line. MCP control, self parking and low latency grasp network. Teleop from anywhere or keep it air-gapped and local.

records.name: Introzy
records.tagline: Track referrals from intro to commission
records.description: Track every introduction from handshake to commission. Introzy captures referrals, attributes revenue, and pays partners on time - free to start.

records.name: LinkBit
records.tagline: Free URL shortener your AI agent can use (MCP + API)
records.description: LinkBit is a free URL shortener with click analytics, custom slugs, UTM builder and QR codes. A REST API and an MCP server let Claude, Cursor or n8n create links and pull click stats for you, and a Telegram bot shortens any link you send it. No credit card needed.

records.name: Microsoft IQ
records.tagline: Give AI agents a shared understanding of your business
records.description: Microsoft IQ connects business knowledge, workplace activity, data, and web intelligence to help AI agents understand your organization and make smarter decisions.

records.name: Replay QA Self-healing Mode
records.tagline: Turn user frustration into verified fixes
records.description: Self-healing Mode turns frustrated user sessions into root-caused bug reports with evidence, sent to your issue tracker or straight to your coding agent. - always-on user session capture (powered by Fullstory) - automatic detection of user frustration signals - Bug reports with detailed root-cause analysis + runtime evidence - pipe them into your issue tracker of choice or straight to your coding agent or factory loop - Daily summary reports of what users did

records.name: AssemblyAI-STT-3.7
records.tagline: Speech-to-Text for live calls, voice agents, and recordings
records.description: AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 is a family of three Speech-to-Text models, one for each kind of audio. AssemblyAI-STT-3.7-Realtime is for live meetings and calls, with speaker labels as people talk. AssemblyAI-STT-3.7-Realtime-Agent is for voice agents. AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 is for recorded audio. All three cover 32 languages.

records.name: Beacon
records.tagline: Give your AI agent the browser you're already signed into
records.description: Beacon is an MCP extension that lets Cursor, Claude Code and any MCP client work inside your own signed-in Chrome. Read the page, click, type, navigate. Multiple profiles, parallel tasks in tab groups, no cookie export, no cloud browser.

records.name: AI Canvas
records.tagline: A design system for AI agents to design badass interfaces
records.description: No more AI slop. AI Canvas gives your AI agent a real design system to build with. The Andromeda Pro AI Brain tells it which tokens and patterns to use, and its done-gate fails work that drifts off the system. Add standalone React components and effects, 820 React icons in four styles, and one MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, VS Code and more search and install it all as editable source. Start free with MIT components and Line icons.

records.name: Diagramly 2.0
records.tagline: Type a diagram. Get it reviewed. Present it as the deck.
records.description: Type Client -> API -> DB and get a hand-drawn diagram. Now send it for review with edit, comment or view-only links, pin comments to shapes, and present it as slides with speaker notes. 18 skins, 10 cheat sheets, Teams. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: Rithub
records.tagline: Own code host, move from GitHub in 5 minutes
records.description: Rithub is your own Git host at rithub.dev: repos, pull requests, issues and CI, plus a guided importer that moves a GitHub repo over in about 5 minutes (walkthrough: rithub.dev/assets/seo/move-from-github-5-minutes.html). See how it compares to GitHub at rithub.dev/assets/seo/rithub-vs-github.html. Ritgram, the social layer for your commits and releases, runs alongside it at ritgram.rithub.dev. Free to start.

records.name: Afterall Photo
records.tagline: Line up your after photo exactly with your before
records.description: Afterall puts your earlier photo on the live camera as a see-through ghost, so every after-shot lines up with the before. Export the change as a crossfade, a reveal or side by side. No account, no server, Pro is a one-time purchase.

records.name: worldinmotion
records.tagline: Encrypted messages between AI agents, across vendors
records.description: Open-source, end-to-end encrypted messaging between AI agent sessions (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, any MCP client) across machines, built to cross accounts. The relay sees only metadata, never the text. No account, no telemetry. Set up with: npx worldinmotion setup

records.name: StoicCloud
records.tagline: Cloud storage for films that only your Mac can read
records.description: The shoot's done and the disk is full. StoicCloud keeps every film in the cloud, encrypted on your Mac before it leaves, so even we only hold noise. Play it instantly in Stoic Player, open it from a Finder drive in DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or Premiere Pro, or share it with a link. 10 GB free with every Stoic Player licence, then 100 GB to 4 TB, or bring your own bucket.

records.name: Dream by Smart Jelly
records.tagline: An AI agent that works through your tasks overnight
records.description: Dream helps you make progress on your tasks while you sleep. It works through tasks it can finish on its own overnight and shows you what it did in the morning. Dream is part of Smart Jelly, a Mac app whose tools share memory of your work.

records.name: Vanira
records.tagline: Voice, video & multimodal AI agent infrastructure
records.description: Vanira is infrastructure for real-time voice, video and multimodal AI agents. Agents talk to people, see what they show on camera or screen, and get work done: video KYC, claims checks, AI interviews, onboarding and support. Developers build with our SDKs and APIs; enterprises can run the full stack on-premise, fine-tuned models included. Inbound Pilot, our AI receptionist for small businesses, runs on Vanira.

records.name: Yetly
records.tagline: Small real-world challenges near you, on your own map
records.description: Yetly turns real places around you into small challenges: have a picnic by a lake, join a guided tour, cycle to a park. Browse nearby ideas across nature, cycling, hiking, culture and city exploring, or grab a ready-made day plan with a few easy stops. Each challenge you finish becomes a footprint on your own map, and you can turn it into a share card. Free for iPhone, no account needed.

records.name: UI Verify
records.tagline: Visual testing for coding agents
records.description: UI Verify shows your coding agent every screen its change touched, so the agent catches and fixes its own UI bugs before your users see them. Used by teams at JetBrains, Cura and Metica. Works with Playwright, Storybook, Vitest and Bun, and with iOS and Android apps. Set up in one line. Free to start, and free for open source: 50,000 snapshots a month.

records.name: uRun
records.tagline: Real-time decisions for voice and video agents
records.description: Sense is a real-time decision model for voice and video agents. It runs on streaming audio and video and answers your questions about the conversation many times per second: is the user done speaking, did they just interrupt, should the agent stop talking. You write the questions, Sense returns the decisions, and your agent acts on them. Build with the SDK for real-time sessions, or send single requests to explore. New accounts start with 1,000 in free credits.

records.name: Confidential Cloud
records.tagline: Private AI cloud that can't see your stuff
records.description: When you press send on a prompt, do you wonder where it went, and who can read it? Confidential Cloud is the cloud for AI where your data stays protected end to end: encrypted at rest, in transit, and in CPU memory, and protected in GPU memory. The infrastructure provider can't read it. The data center can't. We can't. Every instance returns an attestation report you verify before sending data. Confidential VMs, NVIDIA B300 GPUs, and an MCP server for agents. Now in public Beta.

records.name: Arcade
records.tagline: AI video generator for marketing teams
records.description: Arcade is the AI video generator for marketing teams. Describe what you want, answer two questions, and get an on-brand product video in minutes. Start from a prompt, a screen recording, or what you already have in Notion, Linear, Google Drive, GitHub, and Granola. Your Brand Kit, natural voiceover, and every scene editable. Then post straight to YouTube, LinkedIn, and X. Free to start.

records.name: PDF Master
records.tagline: Fast, Free, & 100% Private PDF Tools in Your Browser
records.description: Free and professional PDF manipulation tools running directly in your web browser. No server uploads, guaranteeing instant speed and absolute confidentiality.

records.name: 3 Function Electric Cot/Bed
records.tagline: 3 Function Electric Cot/Bed
records.description: Hospital Bed for Sale – Upgrade patient care with a comfortable and functional 3 Function Electric Cot/Bed. It features electric backrest, knee rest, and height adjustments to support patient comfort and convenient caregiving. Its adjustable design makes it suitable for hospitals, clinics, and healthcare facilities requiring reliable patient support.

records.name: Kaylo
records.tagline: AI short video maker: idea in, video out
records.description: Idea in. Video out. Kaylo writes the script, builds the scenes and adds the voice: a ready-to-post short in minutes.

records.name: Westgate Auto Glass
records.tagline: Ancaster auto repair
records.description: Looking for reliable auto glass services in Ancaster? Westgate Auto Glass offers professional windshield repair, replacement, and stone chip repair. Our experienced technicians provide quality workmanship and dependable solutions to keep your vehicle safe. Contact us today for a free quote! Visit: https://share.google/sJVlUgbmXVt87LRSs

records.name: LifeFlow: Real Life RPG To-Do
records.tagline: Turn your life into an RPG
records.description: What if your real life became your best game? LifeFlow is the gamified to-do list that turns your tasks, habits, and goals into RPG progression. Get things done, earn XP, level up your attributes, complete quests, and watch your character grow. You don't play a game that imitates your life. You play by living it. Create tasks, set their difficulty and importance, and let LifeFlow automatically calculate your rewards.

records.name: Posi
records.tagline: The camera that shows you how to pose
records.description: Never know what to do with your hands in photos? Posi puts a translucent pose guide over your phone's camera so you and the person taking the photo can line up the shot together. Explore 435 poses for solo shots, couples and friends, adjust the guide to fit your scene, or use a reference photo of your own. Set the timer, step into the outline and save a photo without the guide. Available on iPhone and Android. Your first photo is free.

records.name: Playhire
records.tagline: Coding interview prep as free games. No sign-up needed.
records.description: Playhire turns coding interview prep into free browser games. Write real CSS and JavaScript to clear Flexbox, Grid, DSA, event loop and system design levels. No sign-up. Earn XP, climb a weekly leaderboard, and finish a Master for a verifiable certificate.

records.name: OldCam - Vintage Camera
records.tagline: Vintage Digicam & Instant Camera App
records.description: A camera app that makes photos look like 2000s digicam shots or instant prints, with 8 cameras, 11 live looks, CCD-style color, grain and a date stamp.

records.name: FileMorphs
records.tagline: Edit, convert and compare files. All on your device.
records.description: Edit and redact PDFs, convert PDFs to Word or Excel, edit images, and compare PDF, Word and Excel versions. Interactive tools run locally in your browser. Your files stay on your device and aren't uploaded for processing. Free, with no account or watermarks.

records.name: Cutdeck
records.tagline: Long videos in. Shorts out — a free clipper for Windows
records.description: Cutdeck turns long videos into captioned vertical shorts, right on your own PC. Paste a YouTube, Kick or Twitch link (or drop an MP4) — it finds the best moments, frames them vertical following the speaker, burns in word-by-word captions, and deals the clips out as cards: swipe right to keep, left to skip. Kept clips export in clean 1080×1920. No account, no watermark, no credits, no uploads — the AI runs on your own free Groq key.

records.name: Ramayana Full Movie Download
records.tagline: Watch and Download Ramayana Movie HD
records.description: Download or watch Ramayana: Rise of a Legend 2026 full movie online in HD 480p, 720p, and 1080p for free

records.name: PromptForge Pro
records.tagline: Create better AI prompts, effortlessly.
records.description: Create, optimise and organise AI prompts in one workspace. Use the guided builder, get practical feedback, explore ready-to-use Prompt Packs and learn at your own pace. Built for professionals and small businesses using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI tools. Available in English and European Portuguese.

records.name: Portfoolio Portfolio Maker & Hosting
records.tagline: Free Portfolio Maker & Hosting for Devs & Non-Techies
records.description: Free portfolio maker and hosting platform for developers and creators—featuring 40+ handcrafted themes, live companion mascots, GitHub sync, an AI ATS resume score, and free custom username.portfoolio.me subdomains.

records.name: edit2offer
records.tagline: our agents help you get the job offer
records.description: our agents tailor your resume for every job application with Claude. Save workspaces, track your pipeline, and prep for each interview stage. edit2offer uses AI agents to: •Tailor your resume to specific jobs •Prep you for interviews with real feedback Early users are already landing offers. → https://v3.edit2offer.com/

records.name: WhatsCRM Hub
records.tagline: AI sales CRM, from ad click to paid commission
records.description: Leads go cold while they wait for a reply. WhatsCRM Hub pulls WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram into one inbox, answers with AI trained on your docs, scores leads and escalates ignored chats. Self-host it or resell it. One-time license.

records.name: The Complete AI Business Series
records.tagline: Six practical AI guides for small business, one bundle
records.description: Six short guides — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity, Midjourney — each built around a real published company result, with frameworks, 8-industry playbooks, 214 prompts and 18 templates. No hype, sources inside.

records.name: Freelance Niche Finder
records.tagline: Find and validate a freelance niche that fits your strengths
records.description: Find a freelance niche that matches your skills, interests, and market demand. Freelance Niche Finder helps you evaluate potential niches, compare opportunities, identify your strengths, and build a focused service offer. Use practical criteria to assess client demand, competition, earning potential, and personal fit before committing to a niche. Designed for freelancers who want to position themselves as specialists and attract the right clients.

records.name: Startup Funding Tracker
records.tagline: Find startups the day they report new funding
records.description: Find startups to contact when they report new funding. Startup Funding Tracker helps sales teams spot prospects, recruiters find potential hiring clients, and advisors time their outreach. We turn daily SEC Form D filings into company and people profiles, so you can see what a business does, what funding it reported and who runs it in one place. Browse free; paid plans add targeted email alerts, advanced filters and CSV exports for your CRM. Filing dates may differ from when funds were raised.

records.name: AutoClipper
records.tagline: Turn long videos into captioned Shorts, Reels, and TikToks
records.description: Upload a video or paste a YouTube link. AutoClipper finds highlights, cuts at sentence boundaries, and explains why each clip was picked. Want a different moment? Select it directly from the transcript in Studio, fine-tune the cut, and export a vertical clip with animated captions in your language. Start with 30 free processing minutes, no card required.

records.name: Six Hunches
records.tagline: Daily trivia where a near miss still scores
records.description: One card a day: six questions, answered by dropping a pin on a map, picking a year or estimating a number. Score up to 1,000 a question for how close you get. Share your score and a friend plays the same card, then you compare side by side.

records.name: BookClipy
records.tagline: Turn customer conversations into confirmed appointments.
records.description: Bookclipy is an AI-powered booking platform designed for businesses that want to simplify appointment management and customer communication. Create your business profile, train your AI assistant with your services and FAQs, and let it answer customer questions and help schedule appointments. Manage bookings, connect calendars, and share your booking experience through your website or WhatsApp. Spend less time managing conversations and more time growing your business.

records.name: 8 Lite Glass French Door
records.tagline: 8 Lite Glass French Door | AUSLux
records.description: The AUSLux 8 Lite Glass French Door brings classic French-door charm to your home, with eight small glass panes set in a crafted maple timber frame. It lets natural light flow between rooms while adding timeless character, and it suits hallways, living areas, studies and dining spaces. The maple can be painted or stained to match your style, and you can choose from clear, frosted, fluted reeded, cathedral or grey tint glass for the level of light and privacy you want.

records.name: Pluswithai
records.tagline: A QA agent that runs your regression tests day and night
records.description: Paste the test case you run by hand. A QA agent runs it in a real browser, shows you every step in plain words and repeats it every night. When something breaks you get the bug, the exact step and the video. Real Playwright code underneath.

records.name: Sunxue
records.tagline: Turn your own context into plans and clearer decisions
records.description: Sunxue helps you plan goals and compare choices using your energy, skills, experience and resources. Define constraints, break plans into actions, and review results. AI suggests; you decide. For iPhone, currently in Simplified Chinese. Gallery images are English translations of the Chinese interface.

records.name: 2FA COUNTER
records.tagline: Your 2FA codes, in any browser
records.description: Paste your 2FA secret key and get a live, rotating code in seconds — the same RFC 6238 TOTP math Google Authenticator uses, computed entirely in your browser. No app install, no account, no phone required. Keys are never sent to a server and never stored; disconnect from the internet and it still works (it's a PWA)

records.name: Social Receipt
records.tagline: See your draft the way they will read it.
records.description: Know how your message will land before you send it. Social Receipt checks the draft you are about to send and hands you a receipt: the exact wording that could escalate things, why it could land wrong, a clearer way to say the same true thing, and the pattern you keep bringing to messages like this. It runs on a rule engine, not a chatbot, so the same draft gets the same receipt every time. Your drafts stay on your device. Free to try, no signup. Pro is $9 a month, Lifetime Beta $39 once.

records.description: Rhythm by Womb WatchAI is the women's health record built on Health Mapping, the Health Awareness System, with AI trained on women. It maps disease origination and progression, measuring deviation against her own baseline, not a population average. Black box AI pattern matches her against bodies that were measured instead of her and calls the mismatch normal. Thousands of her health variables live in one continuous record she owns. Rhythm does not diagnose or treat disease.

records.name: Shield Agent Sovereign
records.tagline: Modular cybersecurity & compliance suite
records.description: An automated 6-module cybersecurity workspace designed to secure infrastructure, prevent API key leaks in real time, and ensure seamless compliance with data protection standards.

records.name: Technology Audience builder
records.tagline: Build your technology audience
records.description: Pick a technology, narrow it to your ICP, and see how many companies and contacts you can reach across 997 installed-base lists. Free, no sign-up. 1. Size a competitor takeout: Pick a competitor, set your deal size and win rate, and see how much revenue sits inside their customer base. 2. See which tools run together: Pick a technology to see what its customers run alongside it, and how many accounts use both. Useful for integration, add-on and partner campaigns.

records.name: Zettai TrustOps
records.tagline: Continuous compliance & DPDP Act assurance in one cockpit
records.description: Zettai TrustOps automates ISO 27001, SOC 2, and India DPDP Act compliance in one platform. Features a unified Common Control Framework, 23-language consent banner, 30-day DSR desk, cryptographic evidence vault, and AI security questionnaire copilot.

records.name: FichaSync
records.tagline: Turn messy supplier Excel & PDFs into Shopify CSVs in 2m
records.description: AI supplier catalog normalizer and Pre-CSV auditor for Shopify, WooCommerce, and PrestaShop. Drop any messy Excel, CSV, or PDF price list, catch duplicate SKUs, missing prices, and unitless specs side-by-side, and export an import-ready CSV in 2 minutes.

records.name: eno.vn
records.tagline: Classifieds where people and AI agents buy and sell
records.description: eno.vn is free classifieds for Vietnam, open to people and their AI agents. Connect Claude or any MCP client: your agent searches listings, posts for your shop, messages sellers and negotiates offers, labelled 🤖 AI. Only you accept a deal.

records.name: AmigoFish
records.tagline: Find podcasts and video channels by taste, not popularity
records.description: AmigoFish helps you find podcasts and video channels that fit you. You rate shows you know, and it predicts what you'll enjoy from people with similar tastes. No popularity charts, ads or tracking cookies. Ratings and predictions are private. Browse without an account; rating needs a free signup. Missing a show? Submit its feed. A ground-up rebuild of a 2006 site once called Catch What You Love.

records.name: SafeOrNah
records.tagline: Check a link or file with security services, votes and AI
records.description: Know in seconds if you can click a link or open a file. SafeOrNah asks up to 11 security services like VirusTotal, adds community votes and an AI investigation, and gives one score out of 100. Your file never leaves your device. Free, with browser extensions.

records.name: StreamBridge for Plex
records.tagline: Stream films into Plex without filling your drive
records.description: StreamBridge is a Mac app that streams films and series into Plex instead of downloading them. Pick from Stremio catalogs or your watchlists and play on every Plex app via your debrid service, with subtitles in one or two languages, timed to stay in sync.

records.name: Kalkulator Pilih Paket MyRepublic
records.tagline: Kalkulator pilih paket MyRepublic
records.description: Masukkan jumlah perangkat, aktivitas, dan anggaran untuk mendapat rekomendasi paket fiber MyRepublic, lalu cek coverage alamat via WhatsApp.

records.name: MOVEGO
records.tagline: Cardio game for iPhone. Your body is the controller.
records.description: MOVEGO turns cardio into a game. Prop up your iPhone, step back, then jump, duck, step aside, punch and strike poses to dodge obstacles and collect coins. The front camera tracks your moves on the phone. Images are never uploaded or saved.

records.name: Car Driving
records.tagline: A perfect driving school with latest vehicles
records.description: We have our sights set firmly on the future and see the new age of Indians as an encouragement to push past conventions and create exceptional services. Our driving school has raised and redefined the standards for driving instruction in the nation, driven by cutting-edge training materials and technology..

records.name: Clonefense
records.tagline: AI clone defense: spot the bots, keep the proof
records.description: Clonefense spots AI bots and scrapers on your site, keeps dated proof of what they did, and drafts the takedown letters to the host, registrar and Google when a copy appears. Free instant scan. WordPress plugin or one 3.5KB script tag. EU-hosted.

records.name: Register Domain Cli
records.tagline: Register domains from your terminal or by asking your AI
records.description: Buying a domain should be as easy as typing a sentence. Register Domain CLI is an open-source tool to search and register domains from your terminal or by asking your AI assistant (Claude, Gemini and more via MCP). Your AI finds the options, you approve the payment, done. - The domain is in your name, not ours - Free to leave: transfer out at no cost - Clear pricing, no hidden extras or inflated renewals - Proper VAT invoices - Open source

records.name: VoraPal
records.tagline: AI-First Growth Platform for Service Businesses
records.description: VoraPal is the AI-First Growth Platform for Service Businesses. It brings Fortune 500 growth systems to every consultant, coach, agency, freelancers, and local service provider. Attract leads, automate follow-ups, manage clients, accept payments, deliver your services and scale, all from one platform. Get more clients, more freedom and less hustle.

records.name: 奇客数据恢复中文版
records.tagline: 一款面向 Windows 和 Mac 平台的数据恢复软件
records.description: 奇客数据恢复是一款面向 Windows 和 Mac 平台的数据恢复软件。无论是文件误删除、磁盘格式化、分区丢失、硬盘 RAW 错误、病毒破坏等情况，都可以尝试找回丢失数据。支持硬盘、移动硬盘、U 盘、内存卡、相机存储卡等多种存储设备，兼容上千种文件格式，包含照片、视频、文档、压缩包、音频等。软件支持扫描预览，扫描功能免费，操作简单，新手也能快速上手。

records.name: KOHME
records.tagline: Your island in one app: food, dives and taxis in Thailand
records.description: Local super-app for Koh Samui, Koh Tao and Koh Lanta: food delivery from island restaurants, groceries, diving and tour booking with local operators, and taxis. Built on the islands, where Grab barely works. English and Thai.

records.name: Mirror Notch
records.tagline: your Mac's notch, live on your iPhone
records.description: Mirror Notch puts your Mac's notch on your iPhone: what's playing, battery and shelf live in the Dynamic Island, with play and skip right there. Copy something on your iPhone, flick it, and your Mac pastes it where you're typing. No account, no tracking.

records.name: Drippy
records.tagline: Network monitor and firewall for Mac
records.description: Drippy shows your Mac's network speed in the menu bar and records how much data each app uses, by day and by network. You can set a data cap and get a warning before you reach it. The firewall blocks apps and domains, always or by network, plan or usage.

records.name: Rithub
records.tagline: Own code host, move from GitHub in 5 minutes
records.description: Rithub is your own Git host at rithub.dev: repos, pull requests, issues and CI, plus a guided importer that moves a GitHub repo over in about 5 minutes (walkthrough: rithub.dev/assets/seo/move-from-github-5-minutes.html). See how it compares to GitHub at rithub.dev/assets/seo/rithub-vs-github.html. Ritgram, the social layer for your commits and releases, runs alongside it at ritgram.rithub.dev. Free to start.

records.name: Whispr
records.tagline: AI-powered customer support with seamless human handoff
records.description: Whispr combines AI chatbots, visual workflow automation, and human support in one platform. Train bots on your docs, website, and live product data through feeds and APIs. Deploy with one script across your website, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Slack. Automate conversations, define handoff rules, and let human agents take over with full context, all from one inbox. Plus, AES-256-GCM encryption keeps your data protected.

records.name: LegacyCloud
records.tagline: Preserve family stories in their own voices
records.description: LegacyCloud helps families preserve stories, photos, and audio or video memories in a private family space. Send thoughtful prompts, invite loved ones to share memories, and collect contributions through public Celebration pages. Designed with older family members in mind, with a 7-day free trial.

records.name: Yarn Thread - Pro
records.tagline: Stealth floating player and reader with a quick boss key
records.description: Yarn Thread - Pro is a stealth Windows utility for discreet entertainment at work. Quietly watch videos or listen to novels in a tiny, semi-transparent floating window. Key features: • Always-on-top window with adjustable opacity • Instant Boss Key to hide the app and taskbar icon • Click-through mode to work right through the window • Video player with playlists and free cropping • Read-aloud text reader with auto-scroll

records.name: Setpiece
records.tagline: Studio product shots and animations from your print files
records.description: Upload the print files you already have, pick a shot, and get 4K stills or an animation of your real product, lit like a studio. Your actual art is mapped onto accurate 3D, so every letter stays sharp. Check the product in 3D before anything renders, ask for changes in plain words, and download wide, square and 9:16 video, GIFs and transparent PNGs. No 3D skills needed, and your first animation is free.

records.name: Rheniva
records.tagline: Create tailored resumes, cover letters, and job applications
records.description: Rheniva helps job seekers tailor resumes, cover letters, and application responses to specific opportunities. Save your experience in Career Vault and reuse it across applications without starting from scratch. Get one free application credit to try it out.

records.name: DreamQBator
records.tagline: Where Dreams Become Profitable Businesses
records.description: DreamQBator turns your entrepreneurial dream into a real business. Discover the right opportunity with DreamID, get your personalized roadmap with DreamMap, and build your brand, website, and launch with DreamBuilder. Then use integrated marketing and growth tools to reach customers and scale. Whether you're starting from scratch or growing an existing business, DreamQBator brings the tools and guidance together in one place.

records.name: HubContent
records.tagline: Turn a product photo or an idea into a finished video ad
records.description: HubContent turns any idea, photo or product into premium images and videos, from concept to finished content, in one place. Upload a product photo and get a campaign image or a commercial; describe an idea and get a finished video. No team, no prompting skills and no complicated tools are needed. It is built for small brands, ecommerce, real estate and food businesses that need ad creative every week. Plans start from $9.

records.name: DYSPLAY
records.tagline: Video calls built for selling, with AI insights to sell more
records.description: DYSPLAY helps sales teams showcase products, understand buyers, and boost conversion. Host video calls in your own branded showroom. Present products in 3D, review documents together, and get contracts signed live. AI captures more than the conversation: it knows what was on screen and how buyers engaged, helping reps uncover objections and prepare for the next call. After the call, share the showroom and see what buyers open. Reps get the full picture, managers get coaching insights.

records.name: Kumpay AEO
records.tagline: See how often AI answers mention your brand.
records.description: Kumpay AEO shows you exactly how visible your business is in AI answers. Run a free AI Visibility Audit and see where ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews mention you and which competitors get named instead. Track brand mentions across AI search, compare against competitors, and get clear fixes: the pages to publish, the listings to claim, and the keywords to own.

records.name: LinkOpen
records.tagline: Make slack://, obsidian:// and other app links clickable
records.description: Notion, Slack, GitHub and Gmail only make https links clickable, so app links like slack://, obsidian:// or vscode:// get stripped or show up as plain text. LinkOpen turns any app link into a normal https link. Click it and a small page passes it on to the app. Free, no signup and no database: the link itself carries the URL. There is also an API, an Obsidian plugin, Raycast and Shortcuts recipes, and README badges.

records.name: Mars Rally Championship
records.tagline: Free 3D rally racing on Mars, right in your browser
records.description: A free 3D rally racing game that runs in your browser: no download, no account, no ads. Drive a pressurized rover across Martian terrain under Mars gravity, chase medal times on six rally stages (forward, reversed and storm boards), race up to 8 friends live, and watch any leaderboard run rebuilt from its recorded inputs. Every board time is re-simulated on the server before it posts.

records.name: Power Pack for Jira
records.tagline: Track ownership, decisions, and sign-offs in Jira
records.description: Power Pack helps Jira Cloud teams keep ownership, acceptance criteria, risks, decisions, and approvals together in each issue. Assign responsibilities with RACI/DACI, track quality checks and mitigation plans, and give reviewers a clear sign-off record. Built on Atlassian Forge. Start a free trial through the Atlassian Marketplace.

records.name: Hoshizora Dome
records.tagline: Free 3D planetarium in your browser — no app, no sign-up
records.description: See tonight's sky in 3D from anywhere: 41,000 stars, 88 constellations, the planets and the Milky Way for your city and time. Spin the Moon and Mars, preview eclipses from any city and fly through the Solar System. Free, no install.

records.name: ReproWise
records.tagline: AI bug reports and UI/UX audits developers can act on
records.description: ReproWise turns bug reports into evidence. Capture a bug once in Chrome (clicks, console errors, failed network requests, screenshots, screen recording and voice notes) and get a developer-ready AI report with clear reproduction steps. Investigations separate facts from hypotheses and link every claim to proof. UI/UX Audit scans full pages for accessibility and layout issues, and Design Match compares a live page with the approved design. Export to GitHub or Jira.

records.name: Zeno Download Manager
records.tagline: Fast macOS & Windows downloader with 1-click browser capture
records.description: ZenoDM is a fast, local-first download manager for macOS & Windows. Accelerate files with multi-connection splitting, pause & resume reliably, grab 4K videos and playlists, and capture downloads in 1 click from Chrome, Edge, Opera, Firefox, and Safari.

records.name: Launch Day List
records.tagline: Attention, auctioned by the day. 100% share of voice.
records.description: Digital ads are opaque and easy to ignore. Launch Day List: one page of curated billboards where the highest bidder gets 100% share of voice. Design your card live, bid from $10, go live instantly, and keep a permanent /win page. Pay via Wise only if you win.

records.name: Nexpert Supply Chain
records.tagline: Turn supply chain chaos into clarity. Save time and money.
records.description: Bring order to supply chain chaos. Nexpert turns scattered inventory, sales and purchasing data into clear priorities, replacing uncertainty with the confidence to make better decisions. Save time on analysis, act faster and save money.

records.name: Pitchline AI
records.tagline: Voice AI pitches your Sales Deck like your best rep
records.description: Pitchline AI turns your sales deck into a Voice PDF with a voice AI rep that knows your company, not just your slides. Give it your website, docs, FAQs, pricing, objection handling and sales playbook. When a buyer opens the link, it presents each slide, stops when they interrupt, answers like your best rep would and offers a call with you when they're ready. You see every question asked and time on each slide, synced to HubSpot and Salesforce. Free plan, no card needed.

records.name: TryOnFrames AI
records.tagline: Try on any glasses from any website — paste any URL
records.description: TryOnFrames AI is a universal virtual eyewear try-on tool that works with any online glasses retailer. Unlike store-locked try-on widgets, you simply paste any product page URL. The AI extracts the exact frame style, color, and millimeter dimensions, then renders a photorealistic photo of your face wearing the frames. Available on web and iOS, with zero server-side photo retention.

records.name: ChargeMaster
records.tagline: Chicago hospital prices, side by side. Free, no account.
records.description: Hospitals must publish their prices, but the files are huge and hard to read. ChargeMaster reads them for 61 Chicago-area hospitals. Say what the visit is, match the billing code, and compare cash and insurer prices with each file's date. Published prices, not quotes.

records.name: MeetPrep
records.tagline: Prepare for meetings, sharpen English speaking
records.description: MeetPrep helps English learners rapidly improve their speaking and communication skills using hands-free shadowing and active listening drills powered by real YouTube videos

records.name: Catfive
records.tagline: Zero-dependency schema & form validation for Rust
records.description: Catfive is a fluent, zero-dependency schema and form validation library for Rust—inspired by Zod, without #[derive(...)] macros. Validate structs, untyped forms, and lists with composable rules, custom error templates, built-in threat mitigation (Trojan Source, XSS, SQLi), and a declarativespek() pattern engine supporting CPF, CNPJ (including 2026 alphanumeric), Luhn, and ASCII ranges. Optional serde & regex features, available on Crates.io.

records.name: Sumfern
records.tagline: Free calculators. Check the math.
records.description: Most calculators hand you a number and nothing else. Sumfern shows the formula, a worked example you can check on paper and the source for any official rate. Over 90 free calculators for US and Canadian pay, taxes, credit card debt and small-business margins. No sign-up; your numbers stay in your browser.

records.name: OpsJarvis
records.tagline: Self-hosted AI ops desk. Humans approve every write.
records.description: Self-hosted AI operations desk powered by Claude + Next.js 15. Triages Gmail, WhatsApp Business, Slack and Telegram, drafts the action, and a human approves every write to Stripe, Paystack, Flutterwave, HubSpot and Xero. Keys stay in yourenv — you own 100% of the source. Open-core (MIT) by Caelara Labs.

records.name: DevPulse
records.tagline: A release radar for your dependencies, sorted by risk
records.description: DevPulse watches GitHub releases, GitLab releases or tags, and Helm chart repositories, and groups what shipped by how likely it is to break you rather than by date: advisories and breaking changes first, then major bumps, then the rest. Mark a repo deprecated or end-of-life, get on-device summaries with Apple Intelligence, and let an agent read your briefing through the Mac's MCP server. Free for 5 repos, Pro is $4.99 once for Mac, iPhone and iPad.

records.name: Afterall Photo
records.tagline: Line up your after photo exactly with your before
records.description: Afterall puts your earlier photo on the live camera as a see-through ghost, so every after-shot lines up with the before. Export the change as a crossfade, a reveal or side by side. No account, no server, Pro is a one-time purchase.

records.name: worldinmotion
records.tagline: Encrypted messages between AI agents, across vendors
records.description: Open-source, end-to-end encrypted messaging between AI agent sessions (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, any MCP client) across machines, built to cross accounts. The relay sees only metadata, never the text. No account, no telemetry. Set up with: npx worldinmotion setup

records.name: UptimeProject
records.tagline: Independent uptime rankings from our own probes
records.description: Independent outside-in uptime for cloud, CDN, DNS, storage and AI APIs. Five probes on three continents; a minute is up only on a strict majority. Public leaderboard, incidents, badges and API under CC BY 4.0. No paid placement; status pages never feed the ranking. 90-day write-up: https://uptimeproject.org/blog/90-days-of-independent-uptime-data/

records.name: Rollify
records.tagline: The card they'll never see coming 🧻
records.description: Rollify turns your message into a roll of toilet paper they pull open on their phone. Pick an occasion (birthday, asking someone out, thank you, get well), rewrite each sheet, add emoji, photos or a Spotify link, and send one link. Question cards come with a YES button and a "no" that runs away. Nothing to install.

records.name: Spaceload
records.tagline: Pick up exactly where you left off
records.description: A workspace manager for macOS. Save every app, browser tab, terminal, editor project and VPN for a project, then close it all and bring it back in one click.

records.name: StagingBuddy
records.tagline: Add Staging Furniture to Empty Rooms using AI
records.description: StagingBuddy uses AI to furnish a photo of an empty room with realistic, listing-ready staging furniture in the style of your choice — for real estate sale and rental listings.

records.name: Purlock
records.tagline: Your website manager
records.description: Purlock keeps your website right. Change a price once and every page updates, synced with Stripe, with sales that start and end on time. Free checks for email deliverability, SSL and domain expiry, hacked sites, dangerous links and cookie banners, with alerts before anything breaks. Scan any site for expired offers and broken buttons. Purlock Growth (beta) gives you daily tasks and shows which ones brought visits, signups and payments. Free plan, plus APIs.

records.name: Grozaak
records.tagline: Know what's in your kitchen and what to cook tonight
records.description: Grozaak keeps one list of the food in your fridge, freezer and pantry, sorted by what expires first, and reminds you before the date. Scan a barcode to add food. Get recipe ideas from what you already have, save recipes from any link, plan the week's meals and keep a shared shopping list. The whole household shares one kitchen across iPhone and Android. Free to start.

records.name: Kairos
records.tagline: Time tracking that respects your focus
records.description: Kairos is a calm, dark-mode-first time tracker for people who want to see where their hours actually go. Start a timer in one click, assign a project or none, then fix entries on a drag-and-drop week calendar with second-level precision. Goals span multiple projects and roll up automatically. Free includes 5 active projects and 3 goals; Pro adds unlimited projects, Pomodoro, and advanced analytics.

records.name: Build Emotion
records.tagline: Learn marketing by doing it, one logged action a day
records.description: Build Emotion is a marketing system for builders who'd rather code than promote. Set up your project, pick from 8 channel groups (email, directories, social, influencers, paid ads, offline, partnerships...), and log each action in 10 seconds. Streaks, a heatmap and channel analytics turn invisible effort into visible progress. Store ready-to-post texts, generate launch posts from your project details, and see how other makers market on the public leaderboard.

records.name: StorePromoKit
records.tagline: Turn grocery deals into print, web, and social flyers
records.description: StorePromoKit helps grocery and specialty retailers turn one Excel or CSV deal list into print flyers, mobile flyers with shareable links and QR codes, social graphics, and product posters. Reuse product photos and choose a ready-made layout.

records.name: Interactive Book
records.tagline: Learn by doing: books with labs, quizzes and a tutor
records.description: Interactive Book turns a book into a short course on your iPhone or iPad. Read a lesson, try the idea in a hands-on lab, test yourself with a quiz, and review with flashcards that come back just before you forget. A built-in tutor answers from the book. Eight books to start: Year 3 maths and test prep, first piano, workplace English, school and life in Australia, phone photography and memory. Each book is free for an hour, then a one-time purchase. No account, no tracking.

records.name: vpsmon Cloud
records.tagline: Monitor your VPSs and homelab with no inbound ports
records.description: vpsmon Cloud is a hosted fleet dashboard for personal VPSs, homelabs and hobby projects. Install the open-source vpsagent on each server with one command. It sends telemetry over outbound HTTPS, so you never open an inbound port. See CPU, memory and disk history across your fleet in one place, and get an email, Slack or webhook alert when a server crosses a limit or stops reporting. $4.99/month for up to 5 servers, with a 7-day free trial and no card. Personal, non-business use only.

records.name: H3 Image
records.tagline: Try MiniMax H3 Image free, then turn pictures into H3 videos
records.description: H3 Image is an independent site where you can try MiniMax's open-weight H3 Image model for free. Write a prompt or upload a photo, generate pictures up to 4K, edit with up to 16 reference images, then turn the result into a MiniMax H3 video. This site is not run by or affiliated with MiniMax or Hailuo.

records.name: LayerSplit
records.tagline: Split any image into editable layers
records.description: LayerSplit turns a flat banner, poster, product shot or AI image into named, transparent layers. It restores the parts of objects hidden behind others and fills in the background behind every layer, so moving or deleting a layer leaves no hole. Download single PNG layers, a ZIP or a layered PSD for Photoshop, Photopea and Affinity Photo. Text comes back as an image layer, not editable type.

records.name: Contig
records.tagline: The local research workbench for sequencing data
records.description: Contig is a local-first research workbench for sequencing data. It runs nf-core pipelines on your compute, self-heals common failures, verifies outputs with assay-aware QC, and adds variant, coverage-readiness, report, family, biomarker, and cohort workbenches. Every result carries citations and hashed provenance. Apache-2.0, no raw-read upload, research use only.

records.name: Browsa
records.tagline: Phantom, the cloud browser your AI agents run on
records.description: If a person can do it in a browser, your AI agent can do it on Browsa. We run Phantom, our own browser for agents, in the cloud: drive it with Playwright, Puppeteer or MCP, or send a task in plain language and get JSON back. Watch it build a shopping list, fill the cart and place a real Amazon order with bank approval. Solves 13 captcha types in-session, each verified by the site's own server. Credits never expire; 100 free, no card.

records.name: 1Gesture
records.tagline: Every connection starts with one gesture
records.description: Before you meet, your guest chooses a small act of good. Your company funds it. A verified good cause makes it real. 1Gesture turns meeting reminders into shared moments of connection: the guest picks a Gesture from as little as $1 - school meals, clean drinking water, or plastic bottles removed from coastal areas - delivered, verified and guaranteed by a vetted charity or NGO. Free plan available, with paid plans for regular Gestures and teams.

records.name: Carta de Navidad.com
records.tagline: Letters to Santa and the Three Wise Men, with daily magic
records.description: ✨ Christmas magic starts with a letter! Carta de Navidad lets children write to Santa Claus or the Three Wise Men and send their wishes on a magical journey. 🎄 Families can return each day to follow their letter’s journey and discover games and Christmas fun facts. 💌 Parents receive a copy of their children’s letter by email, giving them a little inspiration for Christmas gifts. A playful way to share the excitement of Christmas as a family.

records.name: Polyglot Subs
records.tagline: Learn a language from the shows you love
records.description: Two-language subtitles for Stremio, timed to the voices. Every line in the language you’re learning (Japanese, Spanish, German, English, French or Hebrew), with your own language under it. Tap any word to see what it means in that sentence. Each word lights up as it’s said, and Japanese gets furigana or romaji. Apps for Windows, Android phones, Fire TV and Google TV, where the remote shows the word being said. Free for everyone, no ads: it runs on donations.

records.name: StoicCloud
records.tagline: Cloud storage for films that only your Mac can read
records.description: The shoot's done and the disk is full. StoicCloud keeps every film in the cloud, encrypted on your Mac before it leaves, so even we only hold noise. Play it instantly in Stoic Player, open it from a Finder drive in DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or Premiere Pro, or share it with a link. 10 GB free with every Stoic Player licence, then 100 GB to 4 TB, or bring your own bucket.

records.name: Connecter
records.tagline: Your SMB network shares, always connected on your Mac
records.description: Connecter lives in your Mac’s menu bar and mounts your SMB shares automatically: at login, after sleep, and whenever your network changes. Clean UI, secure macOS Keychain integration, and zero friction. Requires macOS 26 Tahoe or later.

records.name: SlideBySide
records.tagline: Share your slides, not your screen
records.description: SlideBySide turns a PDF or PowerPoint into a live, shared deck. Send the link and everyone lands on the same slide. They can point with named cursors, draw, highlight and drop text on it, and you decide who gets to flip slides. No sign-up for you or your audience, and it's free.

records.name: Pdfable
records.tagline: Click existing PDF text to edit it, right in your browser
records.description: Pdfable is a PDF editor in your browser. Open a file, click any paragraph to change the existing text, add notes, images or a signature, then export a new PDF. No Acrobat or install is needed, and you don't need to sign up to edit and download. Your file stays on your device and is not uploaded (except when you use Recognize text). The free plan includes 1 edit + export per day and 10 MB per file. One-time packs start at $9.99, or $19.99/month or $99.99/year with a 500 MB limit.

records.name: Pluppi
records.tagline: Type a topic. Get a video. Edit it your way.
records.description: Pluppi makes the whole video from one topic: the script, an AI voiceover, animated scenes, captions synced to every word, and music. Pick a style (Explainer, Motion graphics or 3D story), type what it's about, and get a finished vertical video. Then change anything: any word, scene, colour, voice or track, or switch the whole look while it plays. Download the MP4. Free: 1 video a day, up to 30 seconds.

records.name: Lucky Drop
records.tagline: Drop, merge, and chase your next high score
records.description: Drop colorful jewels, merge matching pieces, and chase your next high score! Lucky Drop is a physics-based puzzle game you can play free in your browser or on Android. Keep your stack below the danger line and see how high you can score.

records.name: DineFlow
records.tagline: Zero-commission QR dining with <50ms real-time kitchen KDS
records.description: DineFlow is a zero-commission QR dining OS for restaurants. Guests scan at the table to order with zero app download, tickets sync to the kitchen KDS in <50ms, and payments settle directly via UPI with 0% aggregator fees. Try the live sandbox demo!

records.name: Elis Token Saver
records.tagline: Same answer, fewer wasted tokens in Claude/ChatGPT
records.description: Elis Token Saver is an MCP add-on for the AI tools you already use: Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI and Antigravity. It splits each request into smaller steps and runs every step on the smallest model that can do it well, so only the hard reasoning uses a frontier model. Every plan ends with a report of what it saved. On one production account over 30 days, pay-per-token, the same work cost 80% less than on a frontier flagship. Free to start, no card needed.

records.name: Farol AI
records.tagline: Build custom AI agents for your team on WhatsApp
records.description: Farol AI helps businesses create, manage, and use custom AI agents directly through WhatsApp. Build AI agents using natural language, customize them with your company's knowledge and instructions, and give your team instant access to AI-powered assistance. Whether it's marketing, customer support, internal processes, or daily tasks, Farol AI makes artificial intelligence simple, accessible, and affordable for businesses of all sizes.

records.name: Formlite
records.tagline: The form backend you actually own
records.description: Formlite is an open source (MIT), self-hosted alternative to Formspree. Point any HTML form at an endpoint and get submissions by email (Mailgun) and signed webhooks. Auto-reply to every lead, organize forms in workspaces per client or project, and block spam with a honeypot, allowed domains and rate limiting. SSO via OpenID Connect. One Docker image with SQLite: no SaaS, no per-submission fees, your data stays on your server.

records.name: Fleeto
records.tagline: Run your entire car rental business from one FleetSpace
records.description: Fleet, reservations, rentals, payments and your whole team in one secure FleetSpace. Built for car rental companies of every size.

records.name: ChickenSign
records.tagline: Upload a PDF, place boxes, send the link. £9.95 unlimited
records.description: Simple e-signatures for small UK businesses. Upload your own PDF, drop signature boxes where you need them, and send a private signing link. Your signer doesn't need an account. 10 free signatures every month, or £9.95/month unlimited. No per-envelope fees.

records.name: TalentRally
records.tagline: AI candidate evaluation for faster hiring decisions
records.description: TalentRally reads every application against your job, scores each skill on evidence (not keywords) and tells you who to interview first. Proctored tests, AI phone interviews and panel feedback live in the same place. You make the call.

records.name: Blob Buster!
records.tagline: Free cosy block puzzle you can play Co-Op with friends
records.description: A free block puzzle for iPhone, iPad and Android where the blocks are little Blobs with personalities. Play solo and offline, or team up in Co-Op: up to 3 friends share one room code and one team score, and pass pieces to each other. No friends around? Play with 1 to 3 Blob bots. Fair by design, with ads only between games.

records.name: HIITUN MATRIX
records.tagline: One login to manage all your social accounts.
records.description: Desktop workspace for Windows and macOS. Manage multiple accounts across 15 platforms from one place — Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Weibo, X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, Telegram and more. Write once with AI (or your own AI API), publish everywhere, keep drafts, content and account tokens local by default.

records.name: BR Debt Clock
records.tagline: Brazil's public debt, live, from official data
records.description: Independent dashboard with 300+ official indicators from Banco Central, IBGE and Tesouro Nacional: public debt ticking in real time, interest, inflation, credit, jobs and trade. Includes historical series with CSV export, loan and inflation calculators, a Copom/DI rate tracker and more. Free, no signup, not affiliated with the government.

records.name: DrawMode
records.tagline: Give your AI agents software diagramming superpowers
records.description: Turn your codebase into editable architecture diagrams with Claude Code or Codex through MCP. Analyze your systems with one prompt and view the diagrams. Edit the design visually, then ask your agents to implement it. Collaborate live and import Mermaid or PlantUML. On the desktop, diagrams live in your Git repo beside the code, and even complex ones merge seamlessly across branches.

records.name: SantaPhotoAI
records.tagline: AI Christmas Photo Generator
records.description: Turn any photo into a magical AI Christmas photo. Santa portraits, candy cane photos, family Christmas cards — studio quality in 30 seconds. Try it free.

records.name: AI Cliché Detector
records.tagline: Highlight & scrub ChatGPT clichés and robotic buzzwords
records.description: Free AI Cliché Detector & Overused Words Highlighter. Instantly detect and color-code robotic buzzwords like 'delve', 'tapestry', and 'testament' in your drafts so your copy sounds human and authentic. 100% free, client-side, with zero sign-up required.

records.name: A-Tech Workspace
records.tagline: All-in-One ERP, POS, Inventory, CRM, Bookings and Accounting
records.description: A-Tech Workspace puts everything a growing business runs on into one platform. Sell with a POS built for shops, restaurants and companies, manage bookings for hotels and other hospitality or reservation-based businesses, track inventory, run an online store, send invoices, manage HR and keep customers in a built-in CRM, all connected to your accounting. Stop juggling separate tools that don't talk to each other. Free plan available.

records.name: UpReap Equity
records.tagline: AI-native equity platform: built-in or bring your own agent
records.description: UpReap Equity is an AI-native platform for managing your equity when you're short on time. Keep your stocks, savings, loans and goals in one place, and schedule jobs that watch your money for you and alert you when something needs attention. Use the built-in analyst, or bring your own agent: connect your own AI app and use it as your analyst instead. We're launching in Nepal first.

records.name: Aeon
records.tagline: See who's trading a stock, from insiders to Congress
records.description: Aeon turns public trading filings into plain words, so you can see who's buying and selling a stock: company insiders, members of Congress and the White House, big funds and anyone taking a 5% stake. It's free to read, and Pro adds alerts within a minute.

records.name: Telik
records.tagline: The iPhone's Apple TV Remote, for any Android TV
records.description: Telik puts an Android TV into the Apple TV Remote list in iPhone Control Center. Swipe, click and skip 10 seconds, type with the iPhone keyboard, mirror over AirPlay and use the TV in Apple Home with its HDMI inputs. It also brings a new Home screen: Continue watching from all apps, the weather with a 5-day forecast, and the Apple TV aerial screensavers in 4K. One app on the TV: no box, no server, no iPhone app. Free, open source, GPL-3.0. Android TV 13+.

records.name: CleanPDF Merge PDF
records.tagline: Combine PDFs in your browser. No upload, no watermark.
records.description: Drop in your PDFs, drag them into the order you want and merge them into one file. Links, bookmarks and cross-references from your files are kept. Everything happens in your browser, so your documents are never uploaded. Free, with no sign-up, no watermark and no daily limits.

records.name: Tinydot
records.tagline: Turn a folder on your Mac or iPhone into a website
records.description: Tinydot turns a folder into a website: a blog, a wiki, docs or a portfolio. Drop files into the folder and they're live at yourname.tinydot.com. Markdown becomes pages, with [[wikilinks]] and backlinks, so a notes folder or an Obsidian vault publishes as it is. Images, video, PDFs and CSVs show in the page. There's no builder and no deploy step. Tinydot is free, and Tinydot Pro adds your own domain and private sites.

records.name: Lapser Studio
records.tagline: Beautiful Timelapse Recordings. Effortlessly.
records.description: Lapser Studio turns hours of work into beautiful, shareable timelapses automatically. Hit record, focus on your work (or game 😉), and export a polished video in seconds. Lives discreetly in the menu bar, light on CPU, powerful editing capabilities, with 40+ backgrounds or your own. No giant recordings to sort through and edit. Requires macOS 15+. To top it all off Lapser Studio is available via a lifetime license with free updates to boot.

records.name: Holly OS
records.tagline: Scan business cards and never miss a follow-up
records.description: Turn business cards into relationships you can actually manage. Scan both sides, save where you met and what you discussed, organize notes, opportunities, and next steps, then draft personalized follow-up emails to review. Free on iPhone in English and Korean.

records.name: Dream by Smart Jelly
records.tagline: An AI agent that works through your tasks overnight
records.description: Dream helps you make progress on your tasks while you sleep. It works through tasks it can finish on its own overnight and shows you what it did in the morning. Dream is part of Smart Jelly, a Mac app whose tools share memory of your work.

records.name: GemSpot
records.tagline: A map of local spots that aren't on review sites
records.description: The best spots in your city aren't on any review site: you know them because a friend showed you. GemSpot is a map where locals pin them with a photo and how to find them. Follow friends, keep your places in order, and turn a day out into a route.

records.name: Survive Evade Resist Escape
records.tagline: Drop anywhere on Earth. Survive, evade, get home.
records.description: Type any place on Earth and get a new survival mission built from real-world terrain. Choose your landing zone, manage supplies, avoid detection and find your way home. A choose-your-own-adventure inspired by US Air Force SERE principles. No account needed.

records.name: Hilarious AI Kicking Dance Generator
records.tagline: Create funny AI kicking dance videos from photos
records.description: Create funny AI kicking dance videos from photos. Choose hilarious kicking dance, funny meme, and viral motion templates. No editing skills needed.

records.name: Kaly
records.tagline: Lead qualification forms, a Typeform alternative
records.description: Kaly, lead qualification forms with AI. Describe your goal and Kaly AI drafts the questions, the points per answer and the thresholds. Every response gets a score out of 100 and each contact is ranked hot, nurture or cold, so your team knows who to call first. See the score breakdown for each lead, export to CSV at any time, and start free with no credit card.

records.name: FlashFeed
records.tagline: A free microlearning platform for learning anything
records.description: FlashFeed swaps doomscrolling for a feed of short fact cards, quizzes and quick games. Beyond that, it's an effort to make learning free for anyone, anywhere, about anything. It's built on a flexible Knowledge Pack format, so it works for any subject. Packs are researched and written with AI and checked against sources. There are 68 today, from Spanish and philosophy to national parks and space, with more on the way. Free on iPhone and Android, with no ads and no account.

records.name: LEKA
records.tagline: Your technology team. On demand
records.description: LEKA understands your technological environment, its relationships, and its capabilities. Its AI agents take you directly from business needs to action. Understand. Decide. Act.

records.name: Peekin
records.tagline: Never lose a note behind your windows again
records.description: Peekin is a free sticky notes app for Windows, macOS and Linux. Your notes sit as slim tabs on the edge of the screen, above any app: rest on a tab to peek, click to write, then get back to work. Jot a note from anywhere with Ctrl+Alt+N, tick off checklists, set reminders, pin a note on top, or show it only in a chosen app. No account, no cloud, no tracking: your notes live in one file on your computer.

records.name: Testbay
records.tagline: Marketplace to hire real beta testers for your apps
records.description: Testbay is a marketplace where developers recruit real users to test apps, websites, and TestFlight builds in exchange for money or subscription. Get verified feedback and catch bugs before launch. Ask test users specific question and track their behaviour

records.name: Invoral
records.tagline: Professional invoicing software for India
records.description: Invoral helps Indian professionals and small businesses issue professional invoices, proformas and quotations, with taxes, TDS and invoices for clients abroad handled correctly. Add a UPI-QR, track every payment, and work from any browser. Start with a 14-day trial.

records.name: SDK Fit
records.tagline: Breaking API changes, fixed and proven.
records.description: SDK Fit keeps consumer code fitted to the APIs it depends on. It reads the old and new OpenAPI spec (or MCP tool schema), finds the call sites that break, rewrites only the ones it can prove, runs your own checks before and after, and opens a reviewed PR. Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Rust, Go and C#; deterministic and offline; self-hosted; Apache-2.0. No LLM, no force-push, no auto-merge.

records.name: Simple Chat
records.tagline: AI support for Shopify that asks before it refunds
records.description: Simple Chat is an AI helpdesk inside Shopify Admin. It answers live chat and email from your products, orders, policies and FAQs. It handles order tracking, address changes and follow-ups on open issues. Refunds and replacements come to your team as a card to approve with one click. You can also work the inbox from Claude or ChatGPT. No seats and no monthly fee: you pay $0.29 for each conversation that the AI resolves.

records.name: File Converter
records.tagline: 1,000+ file conversions and PDF tools, free, no account
records.description: Convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ODT, ODS, ODP, CSV, TXT, HTML, RTF, PNG and JPG files to PDF and other formats, convert audio and video, and use PDF tools like merge, split, OCR and sign. Free, no account, nothing to install, and files are deleted right after conversion.

records.name: Poca
records.tagline: Your photocard world, always close
records.description: Bring your favorite photocards into your day, from celebrities and idols to anime characters. Scan both sides, organize your cards into albums, and add finishes and private notes. Choose which albums feed Today and rediscover favorites in the app or on your Home Screen with the Poca widget. Available on iOS and Android.

records.name: Heedar
records.tagline: Catch every subscription renewal before you're charged
