records.description: Heedar finds the subscriptions and free trials you sign up for in your browser, lists every renewal on one screen and warns you before you're charged. You confirm what it finds. No bank link, no card data read.

records.name: New Mind Museum
records.tagline: The history of AI, told as a museum you can walk through
records.description: A 3D museum of AI you can walk through, and the first guestbook signed by humans and AI agents alike. Get your visitor passport, hear each room come alive and read the stories behind every model. Free, updated daily, in English and Spanish.

records.name: Visafar
records.tagline: See every country your passport and visas open
records.description: Pick your passport, tap the visas you already hold, and see every country you can enter. A US, UK, Schengen or Canadian visa opens countries most people never check. Every rule links to its official source. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: PDFDistrict
records.tagline: Free PDF tools that run in your browser. No uploads.
records.description: PDFDistrict is a free PDF toolkit that runs entirely in your browser. 21 tools to merge, split, compress, sign, organize and convert PDFs. Files are processed on your device and never uploaded. No account.

records.name: Pentestboard
records.tagline: Hand-reviewed pentest and red team jobs
records.description: Pentestboard only lists offensive security work: pentest, red team and offensive AppSec roles in Europe, the UK and remote. Every listing is reviewed by hand, links straight to the original posting and shows where it came from. Filter by discipline, certification (OSCP, CRTO, GPEN…) and contract type. Built from public ATS feeds instead of scraping, so no recruiter spam and no reposted noise.

records.name: Nudgebar
records.tagline: Sixteen Mac tools behind one menu bar icon
records.description: Window snapping, clipboard history, screenshots, menu bar manager, per-app volume and 11 more tools in one native 8.1 MB app. Switch off what you don't need – it won't run. No analytics, no account. macOS 26, Apple silicon.

records.name: GoTokenMe
records.tagline: Fund ideas with idle AI tokens
records.description: GoTokenMe turns idle AI tokens into real ideas. Creators pitch milestones, funders lend AI agents to do the work, and no money changes hands — only compute.

records.name: Tinge: Film Looks
records.tagline: Offline film looks for your iPhone photos
records.description: Give your photographs a distinctive look with Tinge, a photo editor built around a considered collection of presets. Choose a photo from your library, try different looks, adjust their strength, and refine the image with light, colour, curve and grain controls. Press and hold to compare with your original. Save a full-resolution copy, or update an editable Photos item while keeping its original available to revert in Photos.

records.name: WebhookHQ
records.tagline: Capture, debug and deliver webhooks
records.description: Get a webhook URL in one click and see every request in full. Find out why signatures fail, forward to your servers with retries, and send webhooks to localhost with an open-source CLI. Webhooks only, free to start.

records.name: PrismBox
records.tagline: Try any outfit or hairstyle on your own photo
records.description: 540 garments and 180 hairstyles, on your own photo. An outfit takes about ten seconds; a hairstyle, under a minute. Upload one full-body shot and see a wedding dress, a hanfu, or a new haircut on you — before you spend money on it. $9.99 for 10 looks, one-time, no subscription.

records.name: Supanova Fundraising
records.tagline: Give your fundraising work a dedicated workforce
records.description: Bring your company context into a dedicated fundraising workspace. We have 4,813 people profiles across 989 funds, your autonomous agents can help you find the right investor, create pitches, and support the prep work you want to do next.

records.name: Glove
records.tagline: Phone files and Android notifications on Windows
records.description: Glove is a free, open-source Windows app. Scan a QR to move files between your PC and an Android or iPhone browser. Pair the Android companion for notifications and quick replies. A Developer workspace offers Android screen control and local MCP testing.

records.name: keyspill
records.tagline: Find the secrets your AI coding agents have already seen
records.description: One command scans your local Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and opencode history for API keys, passwords and tokens your agents read or you pasted. Shows what to rotate and how it got there. 100% local, open source, zero deps.

records.name: CredVault
records.tagline: Build trusted data, AI, and software in one platform
records.description: Secure, scalable cloud database platform for modern teams building the future.

records.name: GIF resizer
records.tagline: Resize every GIF frame here. The file stays in your browser.
records.description: GIF resizer on trygifresizer.com sets a pixel width and height for an animated GIF. Apply resamples every frame in the browser, then shows the real file size. Download saves that file. The GIF is not uploaded. Square presets are 128, 320, and 480. Lock ratio keeps the two numbers you typed. Each frame keeps its own wait.

records.name: CabinetPass
records.tagline: Encrypted passwords, 2FA and documents. No account needed.
records.description: A password manager for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android with no account and no company server. Your vault is encrypted on your device with Argon2id + AES-256-GCM and syncs through your own Google Drive (free), or OneDrive, Dropbox or Box. Free plan: unlimited items, 2FA codes, card wallets, 2 GB of encrypted files. Pro Plus $3.99/mo or Pro Lifetime $49.99 once. Open-source Vault Viewer and a $10,000 crack-the-vault bounty.

records.name: CoCodeOp
records.tagline: A shared workspace for local AI coding agents
records.description: Give your Codex and your teammate’s a shared place to plan, delegate and review code. Each lead connects over MCP, creates named workers and runs them on its owner’s machine. Teams work on the same checkout with scoped file access, path claims for overlapping edits and tests tied to an exact revision. CoCodeOp is free, self-hosted and Apache 2.0 licensed.

records.name: Cher Père Noël
records.tagline: Not a wishlist: your kid's own letter to Santa
records.description: Kids write a letter to Santa, not a wishlist: real toy photos, ranked, hearted, signed. The same letter prints for La Poste's Santa office, and Santa's elves in the family secretly pick a wish. French-only, Christmas 2026. Free, no ads. Web, Android app + Chrome extension.

records.name: Agen Keys
records.tagline: Permissions dashboard for every AI assistant
records.description: Connect your email, calendar, files and docs once, and set each one to Full, Read only, or Off. Then give each Muse, Dots, Instinct, and more, their own keys. Remove an assistant any time and its key stops working.

records.name: Queriez
records.tagline: Topic-focused community to ask, share and post updates
records.description: Queriez is a community where you share problems, incidents and announcements with people who care about the topic. Posts reach readers in staged waves, you earn Qred reputation for helpful contributions, and discussions happen in real time.

records.name: NEFLYX
records.tagline: MAC Jeans for women and men, in every waist and length
records.description: NEFLYX is an online store dedicated to MAC Jeans for women and men. Find fits like Dream, Rich, Melanie and Arne across waists and lengths, with free shipping to the Netherlands and Belgium and 14 days to return. Shop in English, Dutch, French or German, or let your AI assistant search the catalog and get size advice.

records.name: Pixie
records.tagline: Your website's personal AI recipe concierge
records.description: Pixie brings conversational AI to food blogs and recipe websites. Instead of searching with keywords, visitors can describe what they're looking for via text or voice. Pixie listens, recommends recipes from your collection, and helps them plan, prepare, and cook with your original videos. No invented recipes, no sending visitors elsewhere. Just a more personal way to explore your content, right on your website.

records.name: SayCal
records.tagline: Track calories by talking once a day, not logging all day
records.description: SayCal turns what you say into a food log. At night, say your whole day ("oats in the morning, biryani for lunch, two chapatis and dal for dinner") and it sorts every food into its meal with calories, protein, carbs and fat. Built for people who gave up because searching for every food or photographing every meal was a chore. What makes it different: Fact check shows which numbers are checked and which are estimates, and Indian portions like a katori come out right. iPhone, free for 3 days.

records.name: Email Finder Verifier
records.tagline: Find and verify emails, at scale.
records.description: An API that tells you if a work email is real, and finds the right address from a name and a domain. Free while in beta.

records.name: Loura AI
records.tagline: AI image and video studio, now with effects and UGC video
records.description: Loura AI is one studio for the leading image and video models: Nano Banana, GPT Image, Seedance, Kling, Gemini Omni and Grok Imagine. One account and one credit balance, in English and French. Create from a prompt or a reference picture, add one-click video effects, turn a product photo into a shoot or a UGC video, and use it from Claude or ChatGPT through the MCP server. New accounts start with free credits.

records.name: ViralGo
records.tagline: Free website directory: list your site, get your own page
records.description: ViralGo is a free, moderated website directory for makers. Submit your site in under a minute, with no account, no payment and no backlink, and get a permanent SEO-ready page with your logo, homepage screenshot, tags and structured data. New listings go straight into page and image sitemaps, are sent to Bing via IndexNow and appear in llms.txt for AI search. Today's Picks reshuffles 9 sites daily with live visit counts. One website per person keeps it spam-free.

records.name: Launchpack
records.tagline: Every launch image your product needs, in 30 seconds
records.description: Type a name and tagline, pick a color and drop one screenshot. Launchpack makes 18 launch files in one ZIP: OG image, X post and header, LinkedIn banner, Product Hunt gallery and thumbnail, favicons, app icons, web manifest and meta tags. Everything is drawn in your browser, so nothing is uploaded. OG image free; full kit $9, Pro $19 with more layouts, phone frame, Next.js/Astro ZIP and App Store screenshots. Pay once, 14-day refund.

records.name: Subtone
records.tagline: Years of Apple Watch data, read back in words, not charts
records.description: Subtone reads your Apple Health data and tells you in plain words what it says. Free: a note each morning about last night, and today compared with your own past. With a subscription, AI writes something new every morning, plus your trends, a monthly deep dive and how your sleep, heart, steps and workouts connect. Works best with an Apple Watch.

records.name: Resume Kit Bundle
records.tagline: 8 ATS-friendly resume kits, each with a job match checker
records.description: Eight ATS-friendly resume kits: Core (business), Nurse, Teacher, Student, Engineer, Sales, Customer Service and Admin Assistant. You get 64 Word resume templates that also open in Google Docs, 972 fill-in-the-blank bullets and 8 offline Job Match Checkers.

records.name: Faceless Kit
records.tagline: Faceless animated videos, made by Claude Code or Codex
records.description: Faceless Kit turns Claude Code or Codex into an animation studio. Pick a style or paste a viral video, type your idea, approve the script and stills, and get a finished video with voice, music and captions. Every frame is drawn in code on your computer: no AI video credits, same characters every shot. Styles include Toon Reality, In this town, Documentary and Drama. We update often: when a new faceless format trends, it becomes a style. Mac, Windows, or a skill in Claude Code/Codex.

records.name: SetScout
records.tagline: Track LEGO prices across 100+ retailers in 20 countries
records.description: Most LEGO trackers show you a price. SetScout tells you whether it's a good one. It follows 100+ retailers in 20 countries in near real time and judges every price against the official price, its history and the secondary market. Plus alerts you can preview before arming, fair values and a screener for collectors.

records.name: Soundings
records.tagline: Answer security questionnaires from your code, locally
records.description: Soundings reads your project on your own machine and answers client security questionnaires from what the code shows: which AI providers it calls, where data is stored, how users sign in, how keys are handled. It asks you only what it can't tell, and a checker fails any draft sentence that has no real source. Your code never leaves your machine. No account needed: npx soundings-cli. Scanning and the checker are free; the documents are Pro. An aid, not legal advice.

records.name: Identitas
records.tagline: Paste your website, get a brand kit and design system.
records.description: Paste your website and Identitas reads your logo, colors, fonts and the way you write. You get a beautifully crafted brand book with ready-made pieces, plus a design.md system your AI tools can read. Free scan, $9 a book.

records.name: Derrakht
records.tagline: A place for kids to create and share their own stories
records.description: Derrakht is a creative storytelling platform where Persian-speaking kids can write, draw, complete, and share their own stories.

records.name: Quick Quote
records.tagline: Quotes & invoices that Claude sets up for your business
records.description: Quick Quote is a free, open-source quote and invoice app that runs in your own Claude account. Attach two files, describe your business, and Claude sets it up: products, sales tax, PDFs with a pay link. Works on phone or desktop. Needs a paid Claude plan.

records.name: AI Rap Video Kit
records.tagline: AI Rap Video Generator from Your Photos
records.description: AI Rap Video Kit turns your photos into rap videos. Pick a template with music and a scene ready to go, or buy Creator or Studio to unlock custom music and videos for good. Each new creation uses credits.

records.name: Recipe Chest
records.tagline: Your AI-powered digital cookbook
records.description: Stop the daily dinner panic. Save recipes from any website, YouTube, Instagram, or a photo. Plan your week, shop once, and cook with confidence — alone or with your family.

records.name: 7 Deadly Sins Test
records.tagline: Take the 7 deadly sins test, meet your alter ego.
records.description: Which 7 deadly sins are you? Take the free 21-question Quick Quiz to meet your alter ego, explore seven scores, and personalize an illustrated result card. Want more detail? Try the separate 70-question Complete Quiz. No account needed. For entertainment and reflection, not diagnosis.

records.name: FrontDex
records.tagline: Curated front-end resources, each with a reason to use it
records.description: FrontDex is an open-source, curated index of front-end resources: tools, libraries, courses, inspiration and communities. Every resource comes with one line on why it's worth your time, so you spend less time searching and more time building. Organized by where you are in your work, from idea to delivery. Built in Angola, open to the world, and anyone can add a resource on GitHub.

records.name: Toppertube
records.tagline: Free YouTube learning with courses, notes & certificates
records.description: Toppertube brings 300+ trusted YouTube education channels into one place. Build your own courses, take notes beside the video, track progress and earn verifiable certificates. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: MY VINYL ROOM
records.tagline: Your personal digital vinyl collection
records.description: MY VINYL ROOM brings vinyl collecting and DJ creativity together in one digital space. Organize your record collection, upload and play your own music on a virtual turntable, and sample vinyl directly to create beat sketches with a built-in sampler. Built for vinyl lovers, collectors, and DJs.

records.name: AI Game Makers
records.tagline: Turn one sentence into a full Roblox game, no coding
records.description: Describe your game in one sentence, in English or Chinese. The AI plans the gameplay, builds the 3D map, writes the Luau scripts and adds the UI. Watch it build zone by zone and look around it in 3D in your browser. Then download onerbxlx file and open it in free Roblox Studio to test and publish. A first version takes about 35 minutes on average. Your first full game is free: sign in, no card needed. Not affiliated with Roblox Corporation.

records.name: Handwriting Clone
records.tagline: Turn any document into notes in your own handwriting
records.description: Many people study best from notes in their own handwriting. Handwriting Clone learns your writing from a photo of your notes, letters written on screen, or a printable template, then writes any Word, PDF or text document in it: joined writing, tables, underlined headings, highlighter and two-column paper-saver pages, exported as print-ready 300 dpi PDFs. Free and open source. It runs in your browser, so your handwriting never leaves your device.

records.name: FileSetGo
records.tagline: Fix photos, PDFs, and videos before you submit
records.description: Need a JPG under 200 KB, a PDF under a page limit, or a smaller video? Turn a screenshot of the instructions into a checklist. Resize photos, reorder PDF pages, and trim or compress videos. Pull still frames from the original video, then check your files against the rules and export the finished set. Everything is processed on your iPhone or iPad, and your originals stay untouched.

records.name: Moundlings
records.tagline: A clay strategy game about ants conquering a garden
records.description: Moundlings is a strategy game made of clay for iPhone and iPad. Swipe your blue ant colony from mound to mound and take the garden before the red colony does. The red colony has five difficulty levels and adapts to how you play, and there are eight power-ups. Classic mode is free. Explorer and Builder come with the full version, a one-time purchase of CHF/EUR 2. No ads, no subscription, no tracking, and it plays offline. Available in English, German, French and Spanish.

records.name: Tidlark
records.tagline: Careful Mac cleaner: review first, recover anything
records.description: Tidlark frees up space on your Mac without the fear. It finds caches, app leftovers, Xcode and AI model files, large files and duplicates, explains each one, and removes only what you confirm. Everything goes to the Trash or a 30-day Holding Area first. Also: evidence-based uninstaller, app updates, login items, maintenance and a YARA-X threat check. Runs locally, no telemetry, no account. One-time purchase.

records.name: ViZy Barrierefrei BarRy Pro
records.tagline: Accessibility tools for German WordPress websites
records.description: BarRy by ViZy brings accessibility tools to WordPress. Visitors can adjust text, contrast and visual settings through a modern, customizable panel. Available in Lite and Pro with light and dark themes. Developed by Vigitals in Germany. Currently available in German.

records.name: owlrnd
records.tagline: Adaptive practice exams, built from your own syllabus
records.description: owlrnd writes short, paper-style practice exams from your syllabus, notes or photos of textbook pages, marks them, and builds every next test from what you got wrong. Each track has a goal and stops when every topic is strong. Flashcards in between, spaced on a schedule. Learners preparing for competitive exams set up their own tracks; parents can set them up for school-age children, who just practise. Free to try, open source (AGPL).

records.name: Ownbox
records.tagline: The anti-SaaS Business OS you actually own
records.description: Ownbox is the anti-SaaS Business OS: your people, AI agents, business information and workflows in one system your business owns. A Shared Company Brain, a Business Agent and Machines like the SEO Machine. $149 a month for 12 payments, then it's yours.

records.name: Arcade
records.tagline: AI video generator for marketing teams
records.description: Arcade is the AI video generator for marketing teams. Describe what you want, answer two questions, and get an on-brand product video in minutes. Start from a prompt, a screen recording, or what you already have in Notion, Linear, Google Drive, GitHub, and Granola. Your Brand Kit, natural voiceover, and every scene editable. Then post straight to YouTube, LinkedIn, and X. Free to start.

records.name: Nodeway
records.tagline: Review AI-written code by what it actually touches
records.description: AI now writes more code than anyone can read line by line. Nodeway helps engineers review it. It maps any repo into files, functions, routes, components and database tables, and shows each pull request by what it reaches. Walk through a change in plain words, trace a request to the tables it touches, ask how something works and see the answer on the map, then open and merge the PR. It mapped Activepieces' 22,497 files in 1m 42s. Free for now on macOS, Windows and Linux.

records.name: Vanira
records.tagline: Voice, video & multimodal AI agent infrastructure
records.description: Vanira is infrastructure for real-time voice, video and multimodal AI agents. Agents talk to people, see what they show on camera or screen, and get work done: video KYC, claims checks, AI interviews, onboarding and support. Developers build with our SDKs and APIs; enterprises can run the full stack on-premise, fine-tuned models included. Inbound Pilot, our AI receptionist for small businesses, runs on Vanira.

records.name: Yetly
records.tagline: Small real-world challenges near you, on your own map
records.description: Yetly turns real places around you into small challenges: have a picnic by a lake, join a guided tour, cycle to a park. Browse nearby ideas across nature, cycling, hiking, culture and city exploring, or grab a ready-made day plan with a few easy stops. Each challenge you finish becomes a footprint on your own map, and you can turn it into a share card. Free for iPhone, no account needed.

records.name: Radha Naam Jap
records.tagline: A calm digital mala counter for daily mantra chanting
records.description: Radha Naam Jap is a digital mala for daily mantra japa. Tap once for every naam, with a gentle vibration so you can chant with your eyes closed, and the app counts your 108-bead malas for you. Set a lifetime sankalp, build a daily streak, get Brahma Muhurta reminders and keep chanting offline. Radhe Radhe, Hare Krishna, Jai Shri Ram, Om Namah Shivaya and more, in Hindi and English. No ads, ever.

records.name: Searoom
records.tagline: A Mac cleaner that explains everything and only uses Trash
records.description: Searoom shows what fills your Mac and explains every item in one sentence, System Data included. Cleaning only moves files to the Trash, so everything can be put back. It removes apps with their leftovers and keeps your apps updated (Sparkle, Homebrew, App Store) with signature checks. Space is measured after the Trash is emptied, never estimated. No tracking, no account, no subscription: free version for good, Pro is EUR 29 once for 2 Macs. macOS 26+, English and German.

records.name: UI Verify
records.tagline: Visual testing for coding agents
records.description: UI Verify shows your coding agent every screen its change touched, so the agent catches and fixes its own UI bugs before your users see them. Used by teams at JetBrains, Cura and Metica. Works with Playwright, Storybook, Vitest and Bun, and with iOS and Android apps. Set up in one line. Free to start, and free for open source: 50,000 snapshots a month.

records.name: uRun
records.tagline: Real-time decisions for voice and video agents
records.description: Sense is a real-time decision model for voice and video agents. It runs on streaming audio and video and answers your questions about the conversation many times per second: is the user done speaking, did they just interrupt, should the agent stop talking. You write the questions, Sense returns the decisions, and your agent acts on them. Build with the SDK for real-time sessions, or send single requests to explore. New accounts start with 1,000 in free credits.

records.name: Confidential Cloud
records.tagline: Private AI cloud that can't see your stuff
records.description: When you press send on a prompt, do you wonder where it went, and who can read it? Confidential Cloud is the cloud for AI where your data stays protected end to end: encrypted at rest, in transit, and in CPU memory, and protected in GPU memory. The infrastructure provider can't read it. The data center can't. We can't. Every instance returns an attestation report you verify before sending data. Confidential VMs, NVIDIA B300 GPUs, and an MCP server for agents. Now in public Beta.

records.name: Esgenix
records.tagline: Protect your innovation at the speed of AI
records.description: AI is accelerating innovation. Why should protecting an innovation still take weeks or months? 𝗘𝘀𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗶𝘅 turns an invention idea into examiner-ready patent claims, specifications and drawings. Humans strategise, Esgenix executes. 𝗔𝗹𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘆 𝘁𝗿𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗱 by IP law firms and gaining traction with leading EV manufacturers. Patenting is hard. Esgenix delivers, so we charge for 𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘀, 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝘀𝗲𝗮𝘁𝘀.

records.name: Thimble Travel
records.tagline: Your whole trip, planned in minutes
records.description: Tell Thimble where you're going, and it plans every day of your trip around real places, with must-dos, local favourites and travel tips. Book your hotel right in the app and save up to 25% with a free account. Once you're there, Thimble shows what's next on your lock screen, even offline. Version 2.0 lets you book tours and tickets, bring friends along and collect a stamp for every country you visit. Free on iPhone and Android.

records.name: CraftForms
records.tagline: WordPress forms that take bookings, payments and orders
records.description: CraftForms is a form builder for WordPress, inside the block editor you already use. One form can take a booking, charge the deposit through your own Stripe, PayPal, Mollie or Square account, send a branded email with a PDF, and block the dates. It also builds product configurators with live prices for WooCommerce. If you move to Astro or plain HTML, embed the same form there and WordPress stays the backend. The free version has no submission limits and no branding.

records.name: Chartly
records.tagline: Charts, trading journals, and paper replay
records.description: Chartly is a self-hosted workspace for charting, manual backtesting, and trade review. Replay saved market data candle by candle, place simulated orders, and review each paper run. Add indicators and drawings, keep a journal book per account, and connect a signed-in MetaTrader 5 terminal on Windows to view broker symbols and positions. Try the browser replay with sample data, or install the full open-source app.

records.name: Vigie
records.tagline: Windows cleaner that explains before it acts
records.description: A task manager and cleaner for Windows 11 (x64 and ARM64). Before any change to your system, it tells you what it does, the risks, and how to undo it. Free version, or Pro as a one-time payment.

records.name: ViZy Mobile Menü Pro
records.tagline: Build custom mobile menus for WordPress with Elementor
records.description: Create modern, customizable mobile menus for WordPress directly in Elementor. ViZy Mobile Menu Pro offers six flexible layouts, including Compact Panel, Editorial, App Navigation, Fullscreen, Drawer, and Slide Up. Customize colors, buttons, animations, and positioning with Light and Dark modes, Glass and Matte effects, expandable submenus, and optional bottom navigation. Seamlessly integrates with WordPress menus. No coding required. Ideal for designers, agencies, and professional websites.

records.name: HeySwaey
records.tagline: AI voice assistant for your Mac's notch
records.description: Say “Hey Swaey” and your Mac does it: opens apps and files, sends email, types for you in any app, explains what's on screen while drawing it, turns videos into captioned vertical clips, and tells you when your coding agents need you. Free to start.

records.name: Blobbo
records.tagline: Free ChatGPT Ads audit that finds wasted spend
records.description: Blobbo is a free, independent ChatGPT Ads audit for B2B SaaS marketers and PPC agencies. It reviews account structure, context hints, bids, wasted spend, and creative gaps. A person checks every recommendation before anything changes. The audit is read-only and never changes bids, budgets, or creatives. Use the free checker to pre-flight ad copy and a landing page against published character limits and policies. Pro is $249/mo and Agency is $499/mo, both with human sign-off before any change.

records.name: Image Compressor Now
records.tagline: Compress images free in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
records.description: Free image compressor that runs entirely in your browser. Shrink JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and HEIC photos with MozJPEG, libwebp and AVIF encoders, in batches, with ZIP download. No signup, no watermark, no limits, and your files never leave your device. Available in 10 languages, plus a free WordPress plugin (beta).

records.name: ShortlistKit
records.tagline: CV shortlists that arrive with the evidence attached.
records.description: Every "AI screening" tool I saw rejected candidates with zero explanation — I watched it happen at my father's staffing office. ShortlistKit is the opposite: every score quotes the exact CV line that earned it. No quote, no credit. Candidates are anonymized before AI ever sees them, and AI can never auto-reject — a human confirms every rejection. Bring your own AI key, pay your provider, zero markup. Free forever; the founder approves every workspace personally.

records.name: Chess Ladders
records.tagline: Ranked chess ladders for your friends on chess.com & Lichess
records.description: Start a ladder, share the invite link, and play your friends on chess.com or Lichess like you already do. Chess Ladders picks up results every hour, updates the standings, and emails a daily summary. No new app to play in. First month free, then $1/month.

records.name: Flurry
records.tagline: Git-compatible source control with immutable changes
records.description: Flurry is an open-source, self-hosted source control system that keeps Git compatibility at the edge and immutable changes at the center. Clone, fetch, and push with ordinary Git; review and land explicit changesets in the browser; work offline with the native fsc client; and connect bounded automation through signed webhooks, statuses, evaluations, and a local MCP server.

records.name: Swipework
records.tagline: Type a topic, get a carousel you can edit, slide by slide
records.description: One topic in, a finished carousel out. Swipework picks the hook, writes every slide and designs it in your brand or a look from any screenshot. Change anything, then export PNGs or a PDF for Instagram, X or LinkedIn.

records.name: agents.org
records.tagline: Describe your startup. Get a company of Claude agents.
records.description: Describe your startup and Claude designs the teams it needs. Give one command, get one result to accept. It keeps your clients, drafts emails you send, and logs everything. Runs on your Claude Code subscription. Nothing runs that you didn't ask for.

records.name: ROAS Lab
records.tagline: See how creative testing moves your Meta ads ROAS
records.description: A free 90-second creative testing tool for DTC brands. You get $1,000 a week for six weeks: launch ads, cut losers, boost winners, deal with creative fatigue and survive Black Friday. Test it with your own ads; they never leave your browser. It's a simplified model, not a forecast, built to show why brands need a steady flow of new creatives.

records.name: Skimp
records.tagline: Your bank SMS, turned into a private expense ledger
records.description: Your bank already texts you every time money moves. Skimp reads those alerts on your phone and turns them into a categorised ledger: no typing, no account, no server. It has no internet permission, so your data can't leave the device. Unsure messages wait in a one-tap review queue. Budgets, recurring payments, insights and split transactions included. Works with major Indian banks and UPI.

records.name: Your Next Tours
records.tagline: Your voice in every participant's phone. No rented headsets.
records.description: Your Next Tours turns a tour guide's phone into a live audio broadcast. Participants scan a QR code and listen on their own phones in the browser, no app or account. It runs on a local WiFi network with no internet, or online with live translation into any language.

records.name: The Exception Register
records.tagline: Investigate where financial regulations stop applying
records.description: The Exception Register examines where financial regulations change or cease to apply. Explore regulatory exemptions, transitional arrangements and supervisory permissions through searchable case files, historical context and verified primary sources.

records.name: PeerMirror
records.tagline: The Personal Feedback Platform
records.description: See yourself through the eyes of your peers. PeerMirror collects anonymous, honest feedback from the people you value most and turns it into personality insights using the Big 5 OCEAN Personality Model. Add between 10 and 25 contacts. Each participant anonymously completes a unique, simple, five minute structured questionnaire. You get an unbiased perspective of your personality from the people who know you best, free from social pressure.

records.name: ApplyGauge
records.tagline: AI-powered CV insights and private candidate matching
records.description: ApplyGauge gives job seekers AI-assisted CV insights and helps recruiters find relevant candidates. Compare your CV with job requirements and prepare for interviews. Recruiters can post vacancies, review anonymous matches and invite candidates to connect. Private, invitation-led recruitment with no placement commissions.
